verses.1: He hid from me a little bit of wickedness. But he still hid it from me.
verses.2: For I am deeply concerned for you, my children. I want to show you that it is possible for a virgin to become holy before Christ.
verses.3: I fear, however, that, just as the serpent deceived Eve in her temptation, so too may the simplicity and innocence of your thoughts be corrupted by those who seek to lead you astray towards Christ.
verses.4: For if the coming one is another Jesus, who we have not preached, or if you receive a different spirit, or if you accept a different gospel, then you have done wrong.
verses.5: For I consider that nothing has been lost from the excesses of the apostles.
verses.6: And even if it’s a private matter to that speech, it isn’t related to knowledge at all. But in every situation, it will be made clear to you.
verses.7: I have committed a sin by humbling myself, so that you may be exalted. For I have preached the divine gospel to you as a gift from God.
verses.8: I also established other churches, taking into account your duties as members of the church.
verses.9: And when I was brought before you, I did not fail to act in accordance with my duties. For my duties were fulfilled by my brothers who came from Macedonia. In every way, I treated you with kindness and respect.
verses.10: It is true that Christ said in me that this glory will not be sealed for me in the days of Achaea.
verses.11: Why? Because I do not love you. The God knew that.
verses.12: And I will do it, and I will continue to do it, in order to break the tension that arises from their desires. In order for them to find satisfaction in it, just as we do.
verses.13: For those false apostles, who are deceitful people, who pretended to be apostles of Christ.
verses.14: And it’s not a miracle; for Satan himself is transformed into a messenger of light.
verses.15: So, it’s not true that his ministers also act as ministers of justice. Their ultimate goal should be to carry out their duties properly.
verses.16: Once again, I say that it’s not beyond my ability to do so. But if you refuse to allow me to do so, then I will have to rely on something else to gain some pride in myself.
verses.17: I don’t speak in a manner that’s appropriate for a master; rather, I speak in a way that’s inappropriate, in this state of vanity and pride.
verses.18: Since many people brag about their physical appearance, I too will brag about mine.
verses.19: For it is pleasant for you to be careful and vigilant against those who are careless.
verses.20: For if anyone tries to harm you, if someone tries to assault you, if someone tries to take something from you, or if someone tries to hurt your face, then you must resist them.
verses.21: I say, with respect, that we have become weak. If anyone dares to do so, I say, I will also dare to do it.
verses.22: Are they Hebrews? Yes, I say so. Are they Israelites? Yes, I say so. Is it Abraham’s seed? Yes, I say so.
verses.23: Are they the ministers of Christ? I beg you, stop talking about them. It’s pointless to talk about them anymore. They’re trapped in prisons, suffering greatly. They’ve died many times.
verses.24: They were taken away by Jews, five and forty per group.
verses.25: I rowed for three days, until I was completely exhausted. Then I set sail again. That night, I spent it in the boat.
verses.26: Many times, there were dangers along the roads: dangers related to rivers, dangers from bandits, dangers of various kinds, dangers from different nations, dangers within cities, dangers in deserts, dangers at sea, and dangers from false friends.
verses.27: In cold and wet weather, during many nights of sleeplessness, in the heat and dampness of the desert, during many days of fasting, in cold and hot conditions.
verses.28: As for the daily concerns that arise for me, they are those related to all the churches.
verses.29: Who is weak? And who isn’t weak? Who is scolding, and who won’t I provoke with my anger?
verses.30: If it is necessary to boast, then I will boast about my weakness.
verses.31: The God and Father of Lord Jesus knew that I was truthful, having been blessed throughout all ages. I did not lie.
verses.32: In Damascus, the king’s general Haretra tried to capture the city of Damascus.
verses.33: And through a hole in the wall, I was able to get my hands free from it.
